import Solution
import EqualSplit.Spec

/-!
Generated by harness/counterexample.py. Refutes `EqualSplit.req_valid_succeeds` (REQ-VALID-SUCCEEDS) for the candidate's definitions
on the failing case

{"amount": 99, "n": 1}

amount 99 among 1 parties
-/

set_option maxRecDepth 100000
set_option maxHeartbeats 20000000

namespace EqualSplit

theorem cex_req_valid_succeeds : ¬ (ValidSucceeds split) := by
  intro h
  have hx := h ((99 : Int)) (1)
  first
    | (revert hx; decide)
    | (revert hx; decide +kernel)
    | (simp -failIfUnchanged only [OneShareEachOn, ConservesOn, WithinOneUnitOn, SignOn, ValidSucceeds, InvalidFails, OneShareEach, Conserves, WithinOneUnit, Sign] at hx <;> (revert hx; decide))
    | (repeat (first | exact absurd hx (by decide) | exact absurd hx.1 (by decide) | replace hx := hx.2); done)

end EqualSplit
